facts.P1_fx_receipts: Probably freely; no restrictive currency controls are generally reported.
facts.P3_local_gateways: Local gateways not researched yet; see the services listed above.
facts.L1_registration: Register with your municipality (Federation) or APIF (Republika Srpska); steps not confirmed.
facts.L2_tax_id: JIB (ID number); a 12-digit PDV number for VAT.
facts.L3_income_tax_foreign: Worldwide income taxed at a flat 10%; rules differ by entity.
facts.L4_vat_gst: 17% VAT above BAM 100,000; exports are zero-rated.
facts.L5_data_protection: A data protection law exists; details not confirmed yet.
facts.D1_id_document: Lična karta (identity card), mandatory from age 18.

watch_out.text: Older guides show BAM 50,000; the VAT threshold is now BAM 100,000.
